description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Braum''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to put himself between the target ally and the closest [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] within 1500 units, and upon arrival grants himself and the ally [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor and [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance for 3 seconds.
description.text: Active: Braum dashes to put himself between the target ally and the closest visible enemy champion within 1500 units, and upon arrival grants himself and the ally  bonus armor and  bonus magic resistance for 3 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Stand Behind Me'' can be [[Self-targeted|self cast]] to instantly grant '''Braum''' the '''bonus''' resistances.
description2.text: Stand Behind Me can be self cast to instantly grant Braum the bonus resistances.

description3.raw: ''[[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]] can be cast during the dash.''
description3.text: Unbreakable can be cast during the dash.

notes.raw: * ''Stand Behind Me'' can be used on allied [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] but not on [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]] nor [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|traps]]. * ''Stand Behind Me'' has a [[File:Targeting forgiveness.svg|20px|link=Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|An icon representing the keyword Targeting forgiveness]] [[:Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|forgiveness radius]] of 175 units. * If there are no nearby enemy champions, '''Braum''' will dash to land up-to 150 units on the far side of his target. * The maximum dash range without enemy champions present is ~650. An enemy champion on the far side of the ally will allow '''Braum''' to dash a total of up-to 800 units. * If [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]] is cast during the dash, [[File:Braum Winter's Bite.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Winter's Bite|An icon for Braum's ability Winter's Bite]] [[Braum#Winter's Bite|Winter's Bite]] and [[File:Braum Glacial Fissure.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Glacial Fissure|An icon for Braum's ability Glacial Fissure]] [[Braum#Glacial Fissure|Glacial Fissure]] may also be cast. * If the [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] is interrupted, neither '''Braum''' nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.
notes.text:
Stand Behind Me can be used on allied minions but not on wards nor traps.
Stand Behind Me has a forgiveness radius of 175 units.
If there are no nearby enemy champions, Braum will dash to land up-to 150 units on the far side of his target.
The maximum dash range without enemy champions present is ~650. An enemy champion on the far side of the ally will allow Braum to dash a total of up-to 800 units.
If Unbreakable is cast during the dash, Winter's Bite and Glacial Fissure may also be cast.
If the dash is interrupted, neither Braum nor his ally receive the bonus resistances.
